original_edge_labels: Arbitrary file download enables reading local application secrets, web configurations, and credential stores, satisfying the authenticated access requirement of the RaspAP web interface.
Path traversal file download enables reading system files (e.g., /etc/passwd or /etc/shadow) to verify the existence of the default 'pi' account and validate unhashed/unmodified credentials.

Administrator privileges obtained via default OS credentials allow reading RaspAP database configurations or modifying web authentication tables, providing valid authentication for the RaspAP web console.

Administrative shell access allows the attacker to execute programs that play audio through connected speakers powered by the Raspberry Pi, creating the fluctuating acoustic load necessary for optical signal recovery.
OS command execution achieved via the web console allows triggering audio playback to connected equipment, generating power consumption variations recoverable via the electro-optical sensor.

Local unprivileged code execution achieved via Oculus Browser UI exploitation allows an attacker to create hard links targeting the log file used by OVRRedir.exe, triggering privileged arbitrary file writes.

Local unprivileged process execution resulting from Oculus Browser exploitation allows interacting with OVRServiceLauncher.exe to capture leaked privileged process handles, achieving SYSTEM privileges.
